name: Conditional Processing Workflow
description: Demonstrates conditional branching based on LLM output

steps.name: Analyze Sentiment
steps.description: Analyze the sentiment of the input text

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a sentiment analyzer. Respond with only one word: 'positive', 'negative', or 'neutral'.
llmConfig.content: Analyze the sentiment of this text: '${input}'

steps.name: Generate Positive Response
steps.description: Generate an encouraging response for positive sentiment

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are an encouraging assistant. Respond positively to the user.
llmConfig.content: The sentiment was positive. Generate an enthusiastic response to: '${input}'

steps.name: Generate Supportive Response
steps.description: Generate a supportive response for negative sentiment

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a supportive assistant. Be empathetic and helpful.
llmConfig.content: The sentiment was negative or neutral. Generate a supportive response to: '${input}'
